pilot.all_approach_rule: CONTINUE if all four integrity checks pass; never outcome-tune
pilot.translation_rule: all four worlds measured for both robots; at least one robot-world strictly exceeds r2 P100 XY excursion
pilot.cost_note: 20 concurrent lanes already run; no 0.34 GPU-h stopping-cost guarantee

speed.denominator: loop wall allocated equally across N lanes, divided by each completed/active task SIM

carry_1m.scope: no completed frame cumulatively passed hold_3s, so no downstream eligibility

door.scope: no completed frame cumulatively passed hold_3s, so no downstream eligibility

place.scope: no completed frame cumulatively passed hold_3s, so no downstream eligibility

frame_scope: acknowledged normally completed worlds only; other worlds listed as uncompleted/unmeasured
frame_definition: at each stored tick: previous gate ever reached and current gate cumulatively reached, matching original StudentFunnel chronology
later_frame_funnel: carry/door/place per-frame flags absent in original recorder; episode-level counts measured above; never fill unmeasured with0
event_gate_scope: counter reconciliation along proposal path; rejected proposals can still issue a software hold command, so issued_ticks/nonzero_wheel_ticks are separate accounting, not downstream cumulative proposal passes
